>
[Share Senses](/Familiars.aspx?ID=136) <actions string="" />
</title>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 214

**Ability Type** Master

</column>

Once every 10 minutes, you can use a single action with the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) trait to project your senses into your familiar. When you do, you lose all sensory information from your own body, but can sense through your familiar's body for up to 1 minute. You can Dismiss this effect.
